threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing captures the email password and SMS code; attacker searches the mailbox and files for SSNs and ID images
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email MFA uses SMS codes; no sign-in alerts or review; SSNs and IDs kept in the mailbox; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 email and files; BP-01; BP-02
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (email MFA by SMS code; new-sign-in alert off); EV-009 (SSNs and IDs in the mailbox); EV-025 (no security training record)
treatment_plan: Authenticator-app MFA with number matching; new-sign-in alerts and monthly review; delete SSNs and IDs from the mailbox (R-004); annual training; P08 runbook

threat_event: Attacker signs in to the ATS with the reused password (or resets it through a compromised mailbox) and exports the candidate database
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No ATS MFA; password reused from an old job board account; ATS export log never reviewed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 ATS (about 3,400 candidate records; some ID images); BP-02; BP-03
likelihood_basis: EV-001 (ATS MFA off; reset by email); EV-020 (browser flags the ATS password as reused); EV-002 (about 3,400 candidate records)
treatment_plan: Turn on ATS MFA; unique passphrase in a password manager; monthly export log review; delete ID image attachments

threat_event: Attacker uses the owner's mailbox to forward a fake contractor bank-change form to the partner's payroll desk and diverts a paycheck
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Partner's payroll desk accepts bank-change forms forwarded from the owner's email without a call-back; owner email MFA is phishable
affected_asset_or_process: Contractor pay through SYS-03 partner; BP-01; partner relationship
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (payroll desk accepts forwarded bank-change forms); EV-013 (no security terms); EV-008 (SMS-code email MFA)
existing_controls: Contractors can change bank details in the partner's self-service with MFA
treatment_plan: Owner never forwards bank changes; written request that the partner accept bank changes only through contractor self-service or with a call-back to the number on file; email MFA (R-001)

threat_event: Full SSNs, dates of birth, and ID images kept with no purpose in the mailbox, laptop downloads, and phone are exposed in any compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention schedule; start forms emailed until 2025; candidates send IDs unprompted; 77 people affected per the 2026-07-23 search
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (start forms and ID images in the mailbox); EV-020 (downloads folder); EV-021 (ID photos on the phone); EV-SI-12 (77 people, 2026-07-23 search)
treatment_plan: Delete start forms, ID images, and SSNs after the partner confirms it holds them; reply to unprompted ID images with a deletion notice; SSNs only in the partner portal or by phone; retention rule in POL-01 8.6

threat_event: AI match add-on screens out qualified applicants in a way that falls more heavily on a protected group (automatic rejection of 236 applicants with no human review)
threat_source: AI vendor model and owner configuration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic rejection was on for two job orders; no validation, bias check, candidate notice, or accommodation path; vendor features (including employment gaps) not reviewed
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (automatic rejection: 236 of 412 applicants); EV-006 (scoring inputs include employment gaps); EV-007 (no notice or accommodation line); EV-025 (no review of the add-on)
treatment_plan: Score as a sort aid only; human review of every applicant who meets the job order minimums; notice and accommodation path in job ads; quarterly low-score spot check; vendor feature list (P10)

threat_event: Client-forwarded background check reports are kept and later disclosed or disposed of improperly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two full reports in the mailbox since 2025-11 and 2026-03; no disposal procedure; clients not told to stop sending them
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (2 client-forwarded reports); EV-025 (no disposal procedure)
treatment_plan: Delete both reports and empty deleted items; tell clients in writing not to send consumer reports; record the disposal

threat_event: Resumes pasted into a consumer AI chatbot are kept by the vendor and used to train its models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Free consumer account with history and training on; about 30 resumes pasted; no AI use rule
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (about 30 resumes pasted; history and training on)
treatment_plan: Delete chat history and turn off training; no personal data in any AI tool without a P10 assessment and approved terms (POL-01 9.5)

threat_event: The back-office partner suffers a breach of contractor data and does not tell the owner in time to answer clients and contractors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agreement has no security requirements or breach notice clause
likelihood_basis: EV-013 (no breach notice clause); EV-033 (partner SOC 2 report)
existing_controls: Partner SOC 2 Type 2 report reviewed 2026-07-23 (no exceptions on access controls)
treatment_plan: Security addendum: breach notice to the owner within 10 days of determination, named contact, annual SOC 2 report

threat_event: Owner-recruiter is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so no one can reach clients, candidates, or the accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single person holds every relationship and credential; email second factor on one phone; no continuity sheet
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (owner performs every function); EV-008 (second factor on one phone); EV-001 and EV-012 (owner is the only user)
existing_controls: Partner keeps paying contractors without the owner
treatment_plan: Weekly continuity sheet; sealed recovery codes with the owner's attorney; partner coverage agreement; reciprocal arrangement with another recruiter (P05)

threat_event: ATS account lost through a lapsed subscription, account takeover, or vendor failure, with no copy of candidate history
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No independent export; vendor deletes data 30 days after a subscription ends
likelihood_basis: EV-003 (no previous ATS export); EV-004 (deletion 30 days after the subscription ends; backups not confirmed)
treatment_plan: Monthly export to the file storage; subscription renewal on a calendar reminder

threat_event: Laptop stolen from the car or a coffee shop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptop travels to client offices and candidate meetings
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (disk encryption; 5-minute lock); EV-029 (laptop travels to client offices)
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; 5-minute lock; strong sign-in password
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low because encrypted data is not personal information under 501.171(1)(g)2. Keep encryption on

threat_event: Personal phone lost or stolen while signed in to email and the ATS, with candidate ID photos in the camera roll
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Apps stay signed in; ID photos in the camera roll until 2026-07-23; remote erase never tested
likelihood_basis: EV-021 (apps signed in; ID photos; remote erase never run); EV-AC-19 (9 ID photos, 2026-07-23)
existing_controls: Passcode; biometric unlock; encryption; device locator
treatment_plan: No ID photos on the phone; test remote erase; sign out of the ATS app on the phone and use the browser

threat_event: A family or smart-home device on the home network is compromised and used to attack the laptop or the router
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared home network; router admin password was the default until 2026-07-23; router firmware status unknown
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (one network shared with family and smart-home devices); EV-IA-5 (router default password until 2026-07-23)
existing_controls: SaaS traffic uses TLS; host firewall; default password changed 2026-07-23
treatment_plan: Separate work network with family and smart-home devices on the guest network; router firmware check by the IT technician

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or the Florida 30-day notice deadline is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training; owner did not know the 501.171 clocks
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (no incident plan or contact list); EV-030 (owner did not know the 501.171 clocks)
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contacts; walk through it once a year; annual training

threat_event: Hurricane closes the home office or cuts power and internet for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single home office; contractors and clients are in the same region
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (single home office in Central Florida); EV-028 (all systems SaaS; partner pays contractors)
existing_controls: All systems are SaaS and reachable from anywhere with the laptop or phone; partner pays contractors regardless
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Charge the laptop and phone and keep a hotspot when a storm watch is issued
